item.title: Community Update - September
item.description:
Greetings Space Marines!

September marks a special milestone for us: two full years of endless battles across the galaxy. We’ve come a long way since launch, and to celebrate our second anniversary, we’re marking the occasion with the release of Patch 15 this October 1st!

But this month isn’t just about looking back, we’re also pulling back the curtain on our strategic battle plan for Year 3, so get ready! ⚔️​

YEAR 3️⃣ ROADMAP

Here’s the Year 3 Roadmap that you’ve been waiting for!

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

For the remainder of 2026, we still have Patch 15 and Patch 16 to look forward to bringing:

  • The long-awaited Chaos Siege mode, allowing you to play Heretic Astartes previously exclusive to PvP. 

  • A brand-new PvP mode featuring Weekly Stratagems, just like in PvE. 

  • A host of gameplay additions.

And there’s plenty more exciting stuff to come in 2027, including:

  • A highly anticipated new class that a lot of you have theorized about is coming early 2027.

  • New Operations and weapons.

  • Reworks to several gameplay features, with improvements coming to some of the game’s core systems. 

Additionally, there are a couple of other cool features that are planned, but not listed in the roadmap. 

We’ve noticed that you like riddles, so here are two new ones about customisation features we’re preparing:

  • something that will expand customization options by 33% 

  • and something that will put our streaming tech to a test.  

As for the DLC content, Year 3 will bring five new Cosmetic and Champion Packs, with the final one remaining redacted for now… But trust us, there’s something pretty cool hiding behind that blank space! 😉​ 

THE APOTHECARY CLASS JOINS THE RANKS

We’ve been following all your speculations ever since we teased the arrival of a new class, and you certainly had plenty of theories… and the majority of you were right! 😉​ Today, we’re finally revealing the truth: the Apothecary is joining the ranks with Patch 17 in the first quarter of 2027! We’ll disclose more info later, so stay tuned!

Additionally, as we said in the previous Community Update, the Apothecary will receive a Champion skin in the same way the Techmarine did: in the update after its release.

PATCH 15 - ANNIVERSARY UPDATE 2

CHAOS SIEGE MODE

Experience the battlefield from a new perspective!

Chaos Siege Mode lets you play as Heretic Astartes warring for the control of Avarax. Cull the Tyranid swarm, and face Imperial forces and Space Marines that will try to prevent you from conquering the hive city.

Currently, there are 2 sectors, but we’re already working on a 3rd.

Here's a short video showcasing a battle against the Imperial forces:

CRUCIBLE 

Challenge yourself with the new Crucible mode to earn Crucible XP and unlock the Lamenters armour set. Talk to the Chapter Chaplain in the Battle Barge to pick your Penances. Penances are personal debuffs that are designed to offer a tougher challenge to end game players. 

Each class has its own set of Penances, and its own progression: for example, playing in Crucible mode with the Tactical will only grant Crucible XP to the Tactical Class, and will ultimately unlock the Lamenters armour set for the Tactical class.

Similarly, the Penances Set is tied to the Class you’re playing: for instance, the Tactical can pick Penances that will reduce the effectiveness of the Auspex Scan.

Penances Sets are separated in 6 tiers, each offering an increasingly harder challenge. 

Finally, you can pick as many Penances as you want, though a minimum amount is required to start playing. This minimum threshold escalates with higher tiers: for example, Tier 1 demands selecting a minimum of 2 Penances, while Tier 3 requires a minimum of 6.

ONE-HANDED THUNDER HAMMER

The One-Handed Thunder Hammer will be added in this update. Available to the Tactical, Assault, Bulwark and Techmarine classes, it’s a fast weapon that can be charged to deliver powerful AoE blows. 

HEROIC WEAPONS & ARMOUR PIECES

3 heroic weapons will be added with patch 15:

  • Power Axe (Frost Axe - Balance): Killing enemies with Executions generates Power Charges that empower your next Whirl Slash. Damage and radius are increased, and enemies hit are slowed.

  • One-Handed Thunder Hammer (Power Maul - Balance): Holding the attack button performs a powerful Ground Slam that consumes all charges, damage increases by the amount of charges spent.

  • Auto Bolt Rifle (Iron Hands): The rate of fire is increased, but gradually decreases during shooting.

New armour pieces will also be added:

  1. Black Templar double shoulder pad

  2. Mark VI Corvus

  3. Iron Halo

  4. Raven Guard Unhelmed

  5. White Scars Unhelmed

[carousel][/carousel]

TACTICAL REWORK

The Tactical class is getting a rework in this update. Basically, we’re changing most of his Skill Tree to offer more diverse and interesting build options. As we revealed in the last Community Update, we’re expanding his melee arsenal with the Power Axe, the One-Handed Thunder Hammer and the Power Sword. Equipping any of these 3 weapons will automatically remove his Primary Weapon.

Additionally, a new Signature Perk will replace the current Signal Jammer to allow the Tactical to use a Bolt Rifle as secondary Weapon. This Bolt Rifle will share the weapon progression (Versions and Perk Tree) with the classic, Primary version of the Bolt Rifle.

The complete perk change list will be available in the Patch Notes 15.0, when the update releases.

WARGEAR SHARING 2.2

This update brings a third slot for Wargear and the ability to equip capes, tabards and iron halos. We’re adding new Ordeals to unlock new items too: 

  • 6 Tabards to the Vanguard and Heavy classes

  • 2 Tabards to the Assault class

  • 4 Robes to the Vanguard and Heavy classes

SEASON PASS DLCs

Patch 15 brings two new cosmetic sets to the table:

🐺 Space Wolves Champion Pack 

The Space Wolves will receive their second pack with a Champion assigned to the Bulwark class, and a One-Handed Thunder Hammer skin comes with it!

[carousel][/carousel]

💀 Exorcists Cosmetic Pack

The Exorcists Cosmetic Pack includes 1 Helmet, 2 Left & Right Pauldrons, 2 Left & Right Gauntlets and 1 Breastplate. The armour pieces are automatically unlocked and added to your armour sets once you purchase the pack. 

METRICS OF YOUR SECOND YEAR OF SERVICE

Two years of battles have passed, and your dedication has been incredible. You’ve successfully held the line against Chaos across the galaxy!! 🙏​

We’ve crunched the data, and the scale of your achievements is staggering. Here is a glimpse of what you have accomplished during the Year 2:

[carousel][/carousel]

Q&A WITH THE DEVS

Got questions about the Year 3 Battle Plan, upcoming battle changes or anything behind the scenes? We’re hosting a Q&A session on Reddit with our Game Director! 

This is your opportunity to share your feedback and get answers to your burning questions about the future of Space Marine 2!

Leave a comment in this Reddit thread, our Game Director will be diving in on Monday, September 28 to respond!

VOTE ON FOCUS TOGETHER!

There’s a poll still up on Focus Together, don’t forget to let us know which Space Marine 2 class is your favourite and share your feedback with us!!

👉 Vote here

That’s it for this month!

Thank you for supporting us and helping us improve Space Marine 2. We remain very attentive to your feedback.

Don’t hesitate to follow us on our social media platforms to stay informed and get the latest news: Instagram, X, Facebook, Threads and Bluesky.

A new Community Event and Twitch Drops are also coming very soon, so stay tuned for more details!

- The Emperor Protects. 🪽

The Focus and Saber Teams.

item.title: Lords of the End Times is OUT NOW!
item.description:
Hey folks,

Lords of the End Times is OUT NOW alongside Update 9.0!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/80339/Total_War_WARHAMMER_III__Lords_of_the_End_Times/

Cast your eyes over the full list of fixes and adjustments coming alongside the DLC and FLC content below.

Watch the Lords of the End Times Launch Trailer now:

To get the full picture on all the free content coming as part of that FLC, including Neferata, the Vampire Counts rework and more, check out our dedicated blog which covers everything not including in these patch notes.

As always, if you run into any new issues after updating to 9.0, please report them over in our dedicated bug reporting sub-forum.

— The Total War Team

Campaign AI

Task management and recruitment improvements

We've made several improvements to how the Campaign AI recruits units and manages its armies.

As part of our work to reduce army clumping/stacking and idle behaviour, we found that the AI was sometimes spending too much time trying to recruit units in situations where recruitment would most likely fail. The changes we’ve made will help the AI make better decisions and keep its armies moving.

What are the changes?

  • The Campaign AI now stores a history of when and where recruitment was attempted per army, making it better at recognising unsuccessful recruitment opportunities and prioritising other options instead.

  • If recruitment is repeatedly unsuccessful, the AI will focus on other tasks rather than getting stuck attempting the same recruitment over and over.

What impact should this have?

  • AI armies should reach full strength more quickly.

  • Recruitment behaviour should be more decisive and efficient.

  • Multiple armies competing to recruit from the same location should happen much less often, reducing clumping and idle behaviour.

 

Army composition quality

We've updated how the AI builds its armies, particularly on higher campaign difficulties.

What are the changes?

  • Elite army templates are now tuned to favour higher-quality units over total unit count when budget limits prevent the army from being filled completely.

  • On higher difficulties, the AI will favour recruiting tougher, high-quality units over raw unit count.

What impact should this have?

  • On Hard difficulty and above, AI armies should contain more elite units and have greater overall strength.

  • Army compositions should feel more effective and appropriate for the campaign difficulty.

 

Warriors of Chaos

Warriors of Chaos factions have been underperforming when controlled by the Campaign AI. These improvements are aimed at bringing their performance back up to par.

What are the changes?

  • Warband recruitment (unit upgrading) now scales more effectively throughout the campaign, based on turn number, and campaign difficulty level.

  • The AI is better at unlocking technology-restricted units.

  • Building priorities have been updated to improve province development and recruitment choices.

What impact should this have?

  • The Campaign AI should be more consistent in upgrading units via the Warband system.

  • Building construction should be more cohesive, with the AI using a better and more appropriate building categories.

  • The faction should perform more strongly overall when controlled by the AI.

 

Archaon

What are the changes?

Archaon's Campaign AI has been updated to:

  • Expand more purposefully.

  • Engage with lore-appropriate enemies sooner.

  • Spend less time tied up in regional conflicts around his starting position.

What impact should this have?

  • Archaon should be a more capable and engaging adversary when controlled by the Campaign AI.

 

With these latest improvements, cases where armies of any Campaign AI stack up around a settlement shouldn’t persist for more than 5-6 turns at the worst. Usually the “clumping” is for around 2-3 turns while the AI is recruiting and reassessing its priorities.

We are aware that there are still some more issues to address, so please keep sending us your bug reports when you experience them.

Update to Slaanesh building chains

Since the release of Tides of Torment, we’ve seen plenty of feedback on Slaanesh's buildings surrounding recruitment. The common theme is that elite units are recruited too early, with Chosen being a primary example, meaning a lot of foot infantry are made redundant early on. In addition to this, there's essentially too many units spread out across multiple buildings.

We’ve made the following changes based on your feedback, with the goal of providing a more balanced, challenging playthrough without adversely affecting pacing.

 

N’Kari/The Masque

Basic Military

Mortal Servants Chain

  • Scented Pavilion (Tier 1) - Devoted Mauraders of Slaanesh (Spears), Hellstriders of Slaanesh

  • Fragrant Pavilion (Tier 2) - Devoted Mauraders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges), Maurader Horsemen of Slaanesh, Hellstriders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Pavilion of Excess (Tier 3) - Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh, Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Pavilion of Perfection (New Tier 4 building) - Chosen of Slaanesh, Chosen of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

Mounted Servants Chain

  • Building Chain removed entirely

Followers Chain

  • Dark Princes Banner (Tier 3) - Devotees of Slaanesh (Crossbows)

Advanced Military Daemonic Mounts Chain

  • Rapturous Circus (Tier 4) - Heartseekers of Slaanesh

BEFORE:

AFTER:

Dechala:

Basic Military

Warrior Halls Chain

  • Halls of Pain & Prancing (Tier 2) - Hellstriders of Slaanesh, Hellstriders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Halls of Blade & Lash (New Tier 3 Building) - Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh, Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Halls of Unattainable Perfection (New Tier 4 Building) - Chosen of Slaanesh, Chosen of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

Advanced Military

Daemonic Mounts Chain

  • Rapturous Circus (Tier 4) - Heartseekers of Slaanesh

BEFORE:

AFTER:

 

New Landmarks with Neferata

  • We have added a new landmark building in the Silver Pinnacle that allows for early recruitment of Lahmian Handmaidens and Lahmian Vampires.

  • In addition to the new landmark, the Silver Pinnacle is now a 10-slot settlement.

  • We’ve added a new high tier landmark for Neferata in Lahmia that allows her to recruit a limited number of certain Tomb Kings units.

  • New Zombie Dragon focused landmarks will now appear across the map. At the start of each campaign, 6 random locations will receive one of these. Those are available exclusively to the Vampire Counts and the Host of Nagash, both for the player and the AI. When playing as any Vampire Counts faction or the Host of Nagash, at least one Zombie Dragon Landmark is guaranteed to spawn relatively close to your starting position. Here’s an example of one:

  • We’ve also made various small changes to the effects of some of the existing landmarks.

Wound Recovery Time Changes

Campaign balance for Wound Recovery time had largely moved into an area where it was redundant, sources of wound recovery time reduction were too plentiful and in many cases characters could overcome wound time entirely. For the player this could mean legendary characters they had just defeated would reappear the very next turn, undoing hard fought battles. While we want to maintain certain characters abilities to recover quickly (Morghur and Vlad as obvious examples), we’ve reduced wound recovery time effects in many places across the game, as well as making specific fixes and additions:

Vlad von Carstein’s Defeated Trait

Vlad maintains his ability to recover quickly (this is now attributed to his ring rather than being innate), and we’ve changed the trait gained from defeating him so it no longer contains wound recovery time. This was a major source of character wound time reduction for many characters in Vlad's area of the world, and any A.I character who defeated him would essentially recover instantly from then on due to its potency.

New Escalating Wounds Feature

(Note that this feature can be toggled in a new campaign setting when starting your campaign)
Characters can now gain a “Recently Wounded” trait after being wounded, this trait will be removed after 10 consecutive turns of not being wounded, however if the character is wounded again within those 10 turns the trait will worsen to its next level. The focus of the trait is to increase a character's future wound recovery time, so a character that keeps dying repeatedly remains wounded for longer. There are 3 levels of the trait:

​

​

​

​

Miscellaneous

End-turn Performance Improvement

  • Reduced campaign end-turn times by up to 30%:

    • Improved armoury management execution cost

    • Improved execution cost of looping through unit abilities

    • Batching of settlement prefab visual changes

    • Rework how the VFX system is issuing commands which results in a reduced overall CPU cost and performance improvement

    • Optimised faction influence map construction

    • Optimised worker thread tasks granularity

    • Other various small micro-optimisations

Skaven

  • Technologies for Skaven no longer require buildings as prerequisites to be researched.

  • Lord Skrolk’s faction effects have been updated to provide buffs for Pusbags and Cauldron of a Thousand Poxes.

  • Throt the Unclean’s Lord effects and unique skill line have been updated to provide buffs to Stormfiend units.

  • Throt’s Flesh Lab mechanic can be used to apply monster mutations to Stormfiend units.

  • Ikit Claw’s Forbidden Workshop mechanic has been updated with upgrades for Stormfiend units.

Magic Items

  • Settra’s New Clothes:

    • With the addition of Nagash to the world we felt it was only right to give his greatest nemesis a bit of love too so we have added 2 new items to Settra the Imperishable:

      • The Armour of Golden Magnificence (Armour)

      • The Scarab Brooch of Usirian (Talisman)

  • We’ve added a new rare talisman, enchanted item and arcane item for the Vampire Counts and the Host of Nagash: Wristbands of Black Gold, Gem of Blood and Whispering Skull.

  • Added two new magic items for the Red Duke:

    • Armour of Blood

    • The Jewel of Unlife

Skill trees

  • We’ve updated the skill trees of all generic Vampire Counts lords, heroes and bloodline lords.

  • Updated the skill trees for Arch Lector and Warrior Priest (Empire)

  • There were also changes to the skill trees of Vlad, Isabella, Helman Ghorst, Heinrich Kemmler and the Red Duke.

    • The hero versions of Vlad and Isabella can now become lords by reaching level 20 and putting a point on a new skill at the end of their unique lines.

  • Updated the skill trees of the Herald of Nurgle and Exalted Great Unclean One (Nurgle).

Traits

  • We’ve added 2 new innate traits for the Vampire Counts

    • Darkbinder (Available to lords) - improves replenishment, healing and dead rise again.

    • Dread Harvester (Both lords and heroes) - improves corpse generation, captured casualties and battle loot

Regiments of Renown update

  • We have added a new restriction to the number of Regiments of Renown that can be in a single army. This is to encourage using Regiments of Renown across multiple armies, discourage saving them as a purely emergency defensive force, and prevent the AI creating obnoxious entire RoR armies against the player (looking at you, Archaon)

  • Going forwards all Lords will have a capacity of 2 Regiments of Renown by default, and as they increase in rank a skill will automatically unlock which will increase it to 3/4/5. Legendary Lords however will increase to 4/6/8.

Sigvald

  • With the addition of the Glottkin to the Warriors of Chaos, the previous balance of one god-focused Legendary Lord per Chaos god no longer applies. As a result, Sigvald is moving from being solely a Chaos Undivided character to also being recognised as a Slaanesh-focused Legendary Lord.

  • The most significant change here means his technologies have changed to be like Azazel's, he has lost access to units of the other chaos Gods and he has greater access to Slaanesh Gifts of Chaos.

Books of Nagash updates

  • With Nagash's arrival we have updated the Books of Nagash mechanic to better suit the number of different factions all vying for control of these powerful arcane artefacts. Currently, once captured, the Books of Nagash cannot be lost and are stored at the faction level. To better represent the struggle between factions for control of these powerful artefacts, Books will now be held by characters or stored in settlements, allowing them to change hands more readily.

  • Books of Nagash are now 'carried' by the Lords of the armies and the Books directly empower the carrier,Books of Nagash can also be traded between your own armies should you wish to put all of them on a single character to make the ultimate Lord.

  • Now that the Books are persistent items in the world that can be carried it also means they can be stolen by other factions, no longer are they permanently attached to the first faction that claimed them.

  • Additionally, all factions can now influence ownership of the Books. Even if your faction has no interest in collecting them, you can still defeat a Book's owner and choose what happens next. You can either send the Book to your capital settlement, denying access to your enemies, or dispose of it entirely, temporarily removing it from the map until it reappears later. This provides a powerful denial tool against factions that rely on the Books of Nagash to empower themselves.

  • This feature also works in Multiplayer, giving Head-to-Head campaigns between multiple Books of Nagash factions a new dimension, the feature also works in Co-Op but Books cannot be traded between allies and Books can be traded between allies. (Edited due to incorrect information in original publish.)

Daemonic Re-Emergence added

  • Every additional Legendary Lord added to the Immortal Empires map means another faction will meet their end relatively early in the campaign, this has led to almost all the minor Daemonic factions being defeated quite early into the campaign reducing the Chaotic presence of the world. 

  • With the arrival of Lords of the End Times we wanted to bring some support to this part of the game by allowing Daemonic factions (including Legendary Lords) to return to the map after being defeated after a number of turns. Now if a Daemonic faction is defeated it can respawn in a province that has high corruption (either Undivided or the appropriate Mono-god corruption type)

Archaon (the Lord of the End Times) updates

With the arrival of the Lords of the End Times DLC we felt it was appropriate we gave some love to the Lord of the End Times himself, Archaon the Everchosen. 

  • Archaon can now assert his dominance over the other Chaos Legendary Lords by subjugating them after defeating them in battle, this means they will then be added as a controllable character in Archaon's faction. If the Legendary Lord was a Warriors of Chaos character their faction is confederated and their settlements are given to Archaon. If the character was not a Warrior of Chaos their settlements are given to a new vassal faction of the appropriate mono-God culture.

    • e.g. Subjugating Skarbrand will add him to Archaon's faction and all his regions will be given to a new Khornate vassal faction that is loyal to Archaon

  • If a non-subjugated Chaos Legendary Lord gets wiped out, some turns after their demise, Archaon will receive a dilemma. You can then opt to fight an army led by the Lord there and then. If you prevail, you get the Lord in your character roster.

  • Archaon's list of potential controllable Legendary Lords far exceeds any other faction before as he can subjugate Warriors of Chaos, Khorne, Nurgle, Slaanesh and Tzeentch characters - Archaon cannot subjugate Beastmen, Chaos Dwarfs, Daemons of Chaos or Norsca however.

  • List of the characters Archaon can now subjugate:

    • Warriors of Chaos

      • Kholek Suneater

      • Prince Sigvald the Magnificent

      • Azazel

      • Festus the Leechlord

      • Valkia the Bloody

      • Vilitch the Curseling

      • Be'lakor

      • The Glottkin

    • Khorne

      • Skarbrand the Exiled

      • Skulltaker

      • Arbaal the Undefeated

    • Nurgle

      • Ku'gath Plaguefather

      • Tamurkhan the Maggot Lord

      • Epidemius

    • Slaanesh

      • N’Kari

      • Dechala the Denied One

      • The Masque of Slaanesh

Hey folks,

Lords of the End Times is OUT NOW alongside Update 9.0!

Cast your eyes over the full list of fixes and adjustments coming alongside the DLC and FLC content below.

Watch the Lords of the End Times Launch Trailer now:

To get the full picture on all the free content coming as part of that FLC, including Neferata, the Vampire Counts rework and more, check out our dedicated blog which covers everything not including in these patch notes.

As always, if you run into any new issues after updating to 9.0, please report them over in our dedicated bug reporting sub-forum.

— The Total War Team

Campaign AI

Task management and recruitment improvements

We've made several improvements to how the Campaign AI recruits units and manages its armies.

As part of our work to reduce army clumping/stacking and idle behaviour, we found that the AI was sometimes spending too much time trying to recruit units in situations where recruitment would most likely fail. The changes we’ve made will help the AI make better decisions and keep its armies moving.

What are the changes?

  • The Campaign AI now stores a history of when and where recruitment was attempted per army, making it better at recognising unsuccessful recruitment opportunities and prioritising other options instead.

  • If recruitment is repeatedly unsuccessful, the AI will focus on other tasks rather than getting stuck attempting the same recruitment over and over.

What impact should this have?

  • AI armies should reach full strength more quickly.

  • Recruitment behaviour should be more decisive and efficient.

  • Multiple armies competing to recruit from the same location should happen much less often, reducing clumping and idle behaviour.

 

Army composition quality

We've updated how the AI builds its armies, particularly on higher campaign difficulties.

What are the changes?

  • Elite army templates are now tuned to favour higher-quality units over total unit count when budget limits prevent the army from being filled completely.

  • On higher difficulties, the AI will favour recruiting tougher, high-quality units over raw unit count.

What impact should this have?

  • On Hard difficulty and above, AI armies should contain more elite units and have greater overall strength.

  • Army compositions should feel more effective and appropriate for the campaign difficulty.

 

Warriors of Chaos

Warriors of Chaos factions have been underperforming when controlled by the Campaign AI. These improvements are aimed at bringing their performance back up to par.

What are the changes?

  • Warband recruitment (unit upgrading) now scales more effectively throughout the campaign, based on turn number, and campaign difficulty level.

  • The AI is better at unlocking technology-restricted units.

  • Building priorities have been updated to improve province development and recruitment choices.

What impact should this have?

  • The Campaign AI should be more consistent in upgrading units via the Warband system.

  • Building construction should be more cohesive, with the AI using a better and more appropriate building categories.

  • The faction should perform more strongly overall when controlled by the AI.

 

Archaon

What are the changes?

Archaon's Campaign AI has been updated to:

  • Expand more purposefully.

  • Engage with lore-appropriate enemies sooner.

  • Spend less time tied up in regional conflicts around his starting position.

What impact should this have?

  • Archaon should be a more capable and engaging adversary when controlled by the Campaign AI.

 

With these latest improvements, cases where armies of any Campaign AI stack up around a settlement shouldn’t persist for more than 5-6 turns at the worst. Usually the “clumping” is for around 2-3 turns while the AI is recruiting and reassessing its priorities.

We are aware that there are still some more issues to address, so please keep sending us your bug reports when you experience them.

Update to Slaanesh building chains

Since the release of Tides of Torment, we’ve seen plenty of feedback on Slaanesh's buildings surrounding recruitment. The common theme is that elite units are recruited too early, with Chosen being a primary example, meaning a lot of foot infantry are made redundant early on. In addition to this, there's essentially too many units spread out across multiple buildings.

We’ve made the following changes based on your feedback, with the goal of providing a more balanced, challenging playthrough without adversely affecting pacing.

 

N’Kari/The Masque

Basic Military

Mortal Servants Chain

  • Scented Pavilion (Tier 1) - Devoted Mauraders of Slaanesh (Spears), Hellstriders of Slaanesh

  • Fragrant Pavilion (Tier 2) - Devoted Mauraders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges), Maurader Horsemen of Slaanesh, Hellstriders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Pavilion of Excess (Tier 3) - Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh, Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Pavilion of Perfection (New Tier 4 building) - Chosen of Slaanesh, Chosen of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

Mounted Servants Chain

  • Building Chain removed entirely

Followers Chain

  • Dark Princes Banner (Tier 3) - Devotees of Slaanesh (Crossbows)

Advanced Military Daemonic Mounts Chain

  • Rapturous Circus (Tier 4) - Heartseekers of Slaanesh

BEFORE:

AFTER:

Dechala:

Basic Military

Warrior Halls Chain

  • Halls of Pain & Prancing (Tier 2) - Hellstriders of Slaanesh, Hellstriders of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Halls of Blade & Lash (New Tier 3 Building) - Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh, Chaos Warriors of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

  • Halls of Unattainable Perfection (New Tier 4 Building) - Chosen of Slaanesh, Chosen of Slaanesh (Hellscourges)

Advanced Military

Daemonic Mounts Chain

  • Rapturous Circus (Tier 4) - Heartseekers of Slaanesh

BEFORE:

AFTER:

 

New Landmarks with Neferata

  • We have added a new landmark building in the Silver Pinnacle that allows for early recruitment of Lahmian Handmaidens and Lahmian Vampires.

  • In addition to the new landmark, the Silver Pinnacle is now a 10-slot settlement.

  • We’ve added a new high tier landmark for Neferata in Lahmia that allows her to recruit a limited number of certain Tomb Kings units.

  • New Zombie Dragon focused landmarks will now appear across the map. At the start of each campaign, 6 random locations will receive one of these. Those are available exclusively to the Vampire Counts and the Host of Nagash, both for the player and the AI. When playing as any Vampire Counts faction or the Host of Nagash, at least one Zombie Dragon Landmark is guaranteed to spawn relatively close to your starting position. Here’s an example of one:

  • We’ve also made various small changes to the effects of some of the existing landmarks.

Wound Recovery Time Changes

Campaign balance for Wound Recovery time had largely moved into an area where it was redundant, sources of wound recovery time reduction were too plentiful and in many cases characters could overcome wound time entirely. For the player this could mean legendary characters they had just defeated would reappear the very next turn, undoing hard fought battles. While we want to maintain certain characters abilities to recover quickly (Morghur and Vlad as obvious examples), we’ve reduced wound recovery time effects in many places across the game, as well as making specific fixes and additions:

Vlad von Carstein’s Defeated Trait

Vlad maintains his ability to recover quickly (this is now attributed to his ring rather than being innate), and we’ve changed the trait gained from defeating him so it no longer contains wound recovery time. This was a major source of character wound time reduction for many characters in Vlad's area of the world, and any A.I character who defeated him would essentially recover instantly from then on due to its potency.

New Escalating Wounds Feature

(Note that this feature can be toggled in a new campaign setting when starting your campaign)
Characters can now gain a “Recently Wounded” trait after being wounded, this trait will be removed after 10 consecutive turns of not being wounded, however if the character is wounded again within those 10 turns the trait will worsen to its next level. The focus of the trait is to increase a character's future wound recovery time, so a character that keeps dying repeatedly remains wounded for longer. There are 3 levels of the trait:

​

​

​

    • Optimised faction influence map construction

    • Optimised worker thread tasks granularity

    • Other various small micro-optimisations

  • Technologies for Skaven no longer require buildings as prerequisites to be researched.

  • Lord Skrolk’s faction effects have been updated to provide buffs for Pusbags and Cauldron of a Thousand Poxes.

  • Throt the Unclean’s Lord effects and unique skill line have been updated to provide buffs to Stormfiend units.

  • Throt’s Flesh Lab mechanic can be used to apply monster mutations to Stormfiend units.

  • Ikit Claw’s Forbidden Workshop mechanic has been updated with upgrades for Stormfiend units.

Magic Items

  • Settra’s New Clothes:

    • With the addition of Nagash to the world we felt it was only right to give his greatest nemesis a bit of love too so we have added 2 new items to Settra the Imperishable:

      • The Armour of Golden Magnificence (Armour)

      • The Scarab Brooch of Usirian (Talisman)

  • We’ve added a new rare talisman, enchanted item and arcane item for the Vampire Counts and the Host of Nagash: Wristbands of Black Gold, Gem of Blood and Whispering Skull.

  • Added two new magic items for the Red Duke:

    • Armour of Blood

    • The Jewel of Unlife

Skill trees

  • We’ve updated the skill trees of all generic Vampire Counts lords, heroes and bloodline lords.

  • Updated the skill trees for Arch Lector and Warrior Priest (Empire)

  • There were also changes to the skill trees of Vlad, Isabella, Helman Ghorst, Heinrich Kemmler and the Red Duke.

    • The hero versions of Vlad and Isabella can now become lords by reaching level 20 and putting a point on a new skill at the end of their unique lines.

  • Updated the skill trees of the Herald of Nurgle and Exalted Great Unclean One (Nurgle).

Traits

  • We’ve added 2 new innate traits for the Vampire Counts

    • Darkbinder (Available to lords) - improves replenishment, healing and dead rise again.

    • Dread Harvester (Both lords and heroes) - improves corpse generation, captured casualties and battle loot

Regiments of Renown update

  • We have added a new restriction to the number of Regiments of Renown that can be in a single army. This is to encourage using Regiments of Renown across multiple armies, discourage saving them as a purely emergency defensive force, and prevent the AI creating obnoxious entire RoR armies against the player (looking at you, Archaon)

  • Going forwards all Lords will have a capacity of 2 Regiments of Renown by default, and as they increase in rank a skill will automatically unlock which will increase it to 3/4/5. Legendary Lords however will increase to 4/6/8.

Sigvald

  • With the addition of the Glottkin to the Warriors of Chaos, the previous balance of one god-focused Legendary Lord per Chaos god no longer applies. As a result, Sigvald is moving from being solely a Chaos Undivided character to also being recognised as a Slaanesh-focused Legendary Lord.

  • The most significant change here means his technologies have changed to be like Azazel's, he has lost access to units of the other chaos Gods and he has greater access to Slaanesh Gifts of Chaos.

Books of Nagash updates

  • With Nagash's arrival we have updated the Books of Nagash mechanic to better suit the number of different factions all vying for control of these powerful arcane artefacts. Currently, once captured, the Books of Nagash cannot be lost and are stored at the faction level. To better represent the struggle between factions for control of these powerful artefacts, Books will now be held by characters or stored in settlements, allowing them to change hands more readily.

  • Books of Nagash are now 'carried' by the Lords of the armies and the Books directly empower the carrier,Books of Nagash can also be traded between your own armies should you wish to put all of them on a single character to make the ultimate Lord.

  • Now that the Books are persistent items in the world that can be carried it also means they can be stolen by other factions, no longer are they permanently attached to the first faction that claimed them.

  • Additionally, all factions can now influence ownership of the Books. Even if your faction has no interest in collecting them, you can still defeat a Book's owner and choose what happens next. You can either send the Book to your capital settlement, denying access to your enemies, or dispose of it entirely, temporarily removing it from the map until it reappears later. This provides a powerful denial tool against factions that rely on the Books of Nagash to empower themselves.

  • This feature also works in Multiplayer, giving Head-to-Head campaigns between multiple Books of Nagash factions a new dimension, the feature also works in Co-Op but Books cannot be traded between allies and Books can be traded between allies. (Edited due to incorrect information in original publish.)

Daemonic Re-Emergence added

  • Every additional Legendary Lord added to the Immortal Empires map means another faction will meet their end relatively early in the campaign, this has led to almost all the minor Daemonic factions being defeated quite early into the campaign reducing the Chaotic presence of the world. 

  • With the arrival of Lords of the End Times we wanted to bring some support to this part of the game by allowing Daemonic factions (including Legendary Lords) to return to the map after being defeated after a number of turns. Now if a Daemonic faction is defeated it can respawn in a province that has high corruption (either Undivided or the appropriate Mono-god corruption type)

Archaon (the Lord of the End Times) updates

With the arrival of the Lords of the End Times DLC we felt it was appropriate we gave some love to the Lord of the End Times himself, Archaon the Everchosen. 

  • Archaon can now assert his dominance over the other Chaos Legendary Lords by subjugating them after defeating them in battle, this means they will then be added as a controllable character in Archaon's faction. If the Legendary Lord was a Warriors of Chaos character their faction is confederated and their settlements are given to Archaon. If the character was not a Warrior of Chaos their settlements are given to a new vassal faction of the appropriate mono-God culture.

    • e.g. Subjugating Skarbrand will add him to Archaon's faction and all his regions will be given to a new Khornate vassal faction that is loyal to Archaon

  • If a non-subjugated Chaos Legendary Lord gets wiped out, some turns after their demise, Archaon will receive a dilemma. You can then opt to fight an army led by the Lord there and then. If you prevail, you get the Lord in your character roster.

  • Archaon's list of potential controllable Legendary Lords far exceeds any other faction before as he can subjugate Warriors of Chaos, Khorne, Nurgle, Slaanesh and Tzeentch characters - Archaon cannot subjugate Beastmen, Chaos Dwarfs, Daemons of Chaos or Norsca however.

  • List of the characters Archaon can now subjugate:

    • Warriors of Chaos

      • Kholek Suneater

      • Prince Sigvald the Magnificent

      • Azazel

      • Festus the Leechlord

      • Valkia the Bloody

      • Vilitch the Curseling

      • Be'lakor

      • The Glottkin

    • Khorne

      • Skarbrand the Exiled

      • Skulltaker

      • Arbaal the Undefeated

    • Nurgle

      • Ku'gath Plaguefather

      • Tamurkhan the Maggot Lord

      • Epidemius

    • Slaanesh

      • N’Kari

      • Dechala the Denied One

      • The Masque of Slaanesh

    • Tzeentch

      • Kairos Fateweaver

      • The Changeling

  • In addition to his new subjugation feature, Archaon is also presented with a choice upon achieving his Short Victory; continue playing as normal or become the Lord of the End Times. Choosing this Lord of the End Times option blocks his faction and his vassals from conquering any more settlements as the campaign is now focused purely on destruction, razing and Devastation.

  • Archaon's faction will instead receive bonuses based on the number of Devastated provinces as a trade off for being unable to conquer any more territory — this decision cannot be reversed, so choose wisely!

New Dark Fortresses

As mentioned during the Glottkin's Campaign Deep Dive stream, we've added a number of new Dark Fortresses:

  • Black Crag

  • Black Pyramid of Nagash

  • Couronne

  • Hexoatl

  • Karaz-a-Karak

  • Khemri

  • Kislev

  • Lothern

  • Naggarond

  • Skavenblight

  • The Awakening

  • The Oak of Ages

  • Altar of Ultimate Darkness

  • Castle Carcassonne

  • Erengrad

  • Ghrond

  • Hag Graef

  • Hell Pit

  • Lahmia

  • Nagashizzar

New Battle Maps

We've added some new battle maps in the free 9.0 update alongside the Lords of the End Times DLC:

  • Middenheim

  • Black Pyramid

  • Nagashizzar

  • Additionally, Realms of Chaos battle maps from the RoC campaign can now appear in Immortal Empires during the Chaos Invasion End Game, based on which type of corruption is present and how high it is.

Audio

  • We have added new VO lines for these legacy characters/units:

    • Karl Franz

    • Archaon the Everchosen

    • Arkhan the Black

    • Luthor Harkon

    • Mannfred von Carstein

    • Isabella von Carstein

    • Heinrich Kemmler

    • Helman Ghorst

    • Updated legacy units 'Swords of Ulric' and 'The White Wolves' to use new Empire voice sets

  • Additional Campaign & Battle Music has been added for:

    • Dwarfs

    • Chaos factions

    • Skaven

    • Empire

    • Undead Legions

  • Reworked SFX for Lore of Vampires

Additional Changes

  • Ulrika Magdova is available to Neferata and can be unlocked via her technology tree.

  • No Lords in Custom Battles Setting:

    • A new setting has been added to custom battles where players can now start a battle without having a Lord.

  • Vampire Counts starting Faction & Lord effects have been updated.

  • With Krell now a unique agent, Heinrich Kemmler’s skill tree has been updated, as mentioned above.

  • Added 2 new abilities for Heinrich Kemmler (note that he no longer has access to the Lord of Undeath ability)

    • Invocation of the Lichemaster (Active - Summon) - summons a unit of Cairn Wraiths.

    • Eternal Vigour (Active - Augment) - melee defence and physical resistance buff for all allies.

  • The Red Duke can now be confederated via the technology tree while playing as any Vampire Counts faction

  • Updated the Red Duke’s skill tree, added a new background trait, defeat trait and a couple of new items for him:

    • New background trait - Scourge of Aquitaine

    • New defeat trait - The Dead Duke

    • New items (also listed in Magic Items section):

      • Armour of Blood

      • The Jewel of Unlife

  • Mourngul Haunters are now available to the Vampire Counts with an updated skill tree.

  • Province Commandments for the Vampire Counts were updated and a new one was added specifically for Neferata.

  • Blood Decrees

    • Vampire Counts factions now have access to new province-level actions that provide various effects in exchange for Blood and Population Surplus

      • Midnight Culling - provides corpses

      • Sanguine Wards - improves provincial defences

      • Tenebrous Authority - increases growth and corruption

  • Arkhan The Black’s faction now has access to additional enhanced Vampiric units through his unique military chain: 

    • Crypt Horror

    • Cairn Wraith

    • Spirit Host

    • Morghast Archai

    • Morghast Harbinger

  • Tomb Scorpion has been moved to a T2 unit.

BUG FIXES

 

PERFORMANCE, STABILITY & GRAPHICS

  • Fixed a freeze that could occur when auto-resolving or returning to the campaign from a battle, caused by research points being awarded outside of the owning faction's turn.

  • Fixed a hard lock that could occur during the end turn cycle if the player ended their turn before the unit recruitment scripted tour had played.

  • Fixed an issue in Tyrion's ‘Dragon Armour of Aenarion’ quest battle which would cause a 15-second soft lock when clicking the Objective Location button for the ‘Survive the Dark Elves’ invasion.

  • Fixed several remaining cases of flickering on the campaign map, most noticeably on coastal ice, when using the TAA and TAA High anti-aliasing settings.

  • Fixed an issue where siege towers and siege rams showed an excessive amount of motion blur when using the TAA and TAA High anti-aliasing settings.

  • Improved TAA to reduce ghosting and blur issues on units.

CAMPAIGN

General & Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where missions that require the player to take a settlement, such as the Warriors of Chaos 'Dark Architecture' mission, would not complete if the settlement was occupied during an enemy turn - for example after a besieged hero sallied out and lost the battle.

  • Fixed an issue where the Slaanesh 'Changing Sides' mission would not complete if the seduced unit was killed in battle.

  • Fixed an issue where Lizardmen technologies with a gold cost deducted their full cost every turn while researching, rather than once.

  • Unit rewards for completed Ivory Road Caravans and Chaos Dwarf Convoys are now granted every time a caravan or convoy reaches its destination, provided the caravan does not already have those units and has room for them.

  • Fixed an issue where Lords could switch into stances that cost Action Points, such as Ambush or Encamp, while on 0 Action Points, for example after a settlement battle or immediately after being recruited.

  • Fixed an issue where Vampire Coast Lords could switch to any other stance after using the 'Dig for Treasure' stance, including stances that require Action Points.

  • Fixed an issue where the Wolf Chariot and Orc War Boar Chariot mounts could be lost from an Orc Warboss over the end turn.

  • Fixed an issue where settlements with special visuals, such as those destroyed by a Doomsphere, reverted to their default appearance after loading a save.

  • Fixed an issue where engaging the 'Tower of Ashair' quest battle as Sayl the Faithless placed the player into a military alliance with the Jagged-Horn Tribe.

Campaign AI

  • Resolved an issue with the Campaign AI's target selection logic for Slaanesh's 'Promise of Perfection'. The randomization logic was not handling the selection correctly, which could result in no valid target being selected.

Diplomacy

  • Fixed an issue where The Changeling couldn't acquire new forms through diplomatic alliances and vassalisation after being confederated by Kairos (requires new game or a save file prior to confederating The Changeling)

Skills, Traits, Abilities & Technologies

  • Characters without ranged attacks now receive the melee-only version of the Weapon Master trait.

  • Fixed an issue where the unique Wight King Kevin von Lloydstein still had the old version of the Weapon Master trait; he now has the melee-only version.

  • The Yvresse version of the High Elf Prince now correctly has access to the Immortality and Mentor skills.

  • The Bloodshriek Chimera is now affected by the Unchained Beasts technology and the Freakish Mutations skill.

  • Fixed an issue where the Doom Diver Catapult was missing from Grom the Paunch's character skills that affect all Goblin units.

  • Added the missing artillery units, including the Casket of Souls, Bone Giant, Cygor, Dreadquake Mortar, Skull Cannon, Stegadon, Necrofex Colossus, Luminark of Hysh and Steam Tank, to the pool of units affected by Zhatan the Black's defeat trait.

  • Fixed an issue where Rakarth's 'Harpyclaw Bolts' skill replaced the ammunition of Reaper Bolt Throwers and restricted them to a single shot type. The skill now adds a new ammunition type that is effective against cavalry and infantry instead.

  • Fixed an issue where Ku'gath was missing battle abilities in the front-end version.

UI/UX

  • Epidemius' Tally of Pestilence now updates immediately after spreading plague, rather than only after saving and reloading.

  • Fixed specific cases where moving the campaign camera right and down by holding the mouse cursor at the edge of the screen did not work.

  • The High Elf scripted tour now correctly displays its name, 'Patrons of the Realms'.

  • Fixed an issue where the fourth step of the 'Patrons of the Realms' scripted tour was cut off at lower screen resolutions.

  • Fixed an issue in the Formless Horror UI where ability icons were hidden behind the Assume for Battle button on lower resolutions.

  • Fixed missing artwork in the Weapon Returned event message in the Realms of Chaos campaign.

  • Fixed an issue where the artwork for the Occupy, loot, raze or sack Victory Conditions requirement appeared as a white box.

  • Fixed a typo in the Norsca Technologies description.

  • Fixed an issue where the Scrolls of Knowledge art cost disappears after performing any action in the Secrets of the White Tower menu and does not reappear after the cooldown.

VFX

  • Aekold Helbrass now displays his battle VFX on the campaign map.

  • The War Mammoth (Warshrine) mount now correctly displays its fire VFX on the campaign map.

  • Fixed an issue where the flame effects on Bhashiva's and Volkmar's weapons disappeared from the character details panel after opening and closing it several times.

  • Fixed an issue where an effect playing in one porthole could sometimes appear in another porthole on screen — for example a Skaven effect appearing on Boris Todbringer in the pre-battle screen.

  • Fixed an issue where the relic indicator above a settlement flickered at the edge of the game window during Bhashiva's campaign.

Units & Models

  • Fixed LOD issues on Morghur's campaign model at very close range.

Rites Cooldown Rebalancing

We have updated the cooldowns for rites as below. Their global cooldown time has remained at 5 turns:

Skaven:

  • The Dominating Scheme: 15 → 13

  • The Thirteenth Scheme: 30 → 13

  • The Pestilent Scheme (Non clan Pestilens): 30 → 20

  • The Scheme of DOOOOM!: 30 → 20

Dark Elves:

  • Sacrifice to Hekarti: 20 → 15

  • Sacrifice to Atharti: 20 → 15

  • Sacrifice to Mathlann: 25 → 20

  • Sacrifice to Khaine: 40 → 25

  • Sacrifice to Drakira: 30 → 25

  • Sacrifice to Anath Raema: 25 → 20

  • Rite of the Warmaster: 50 → 25

Lizardmen:

  • Rite of Primeval Glory: 50 → 25

  • Rite of Tzunki: 20 → 15

Vampire Coast:

  • Curse of the Sea Mist: 30 → 20

  • Curse of Eternal Service: 20 → 15

  • Curse of the Queen’s Cannon: 25 → 20

BATTLE

General & Gameplay

  • Spells can no longer be cast outside of their range when the path to the casting point is blocked by buildings.

  • Units falling back due to skirmish mode are now subject to rampage.

  • Removed the movement speed penalty from the 'sharp stones' ground type. It was never intended to affect units and had no tooltip indicating the area it applied to.

  • Fixed an issue where Tomb Kings and Vampire Counts armies could deploy in a single straight line at the start of a land battle when using a set formation.

  • Fixed an issue where the buffs from Epidemius' Tally of Pestilence did not apply to Epidemius himself.

  • Improved the consistency of damage dealt by Norscan Ice Wolves when attacking routing enemies.

  • Fixed an issue where Exalted Plaguebearers of Nurgle dealt far too much missile damage to buildings, destroying towers and barricades in a single volley.

  • Adjusted the charge speed of Tiger Warrior Stalkers, which was slower than their normal movement speed.

  • Styrkaar of the Sortsvinaer now correctly has the Causes Fear attribute when mounted on a Steed of Slaanesh.

  • The Spawn-Kin passive is now present on Kroxigor Ancients and Nakai the Wanderer.

  • The Celestial Dragon Guard and Celestial Dragon Crossbows Regiments of Renown now have the same mass as their standard counterparts.

AI

  • Fixed an issue that caused the AI to remain idle during the Gotrek and Felix quest battle for some players.

  • Fixed an issue where the AI did not respond when coming under ranged fire in the 'Dragon Cloak of Fyrskar' quest battle.

  • Fixed an issue where Fatsod and several other units became indecisive and wandered the map instead of engaging the player during Kayzk's Devotion battle.

  • Fixed an issue where the reinforcing army arriving with the awakened Lord Kroak remained idle instead of advancing to support the player.

  • Fixed AI behaviour in Queek Headtaker's 'Dwarf Gouger' quest battle, where Dwarf ranged units charged into melee and infantry ignored nearby Skaven missile units.

  • Fixed an issue in Dechala's quest battle where the reinforcing Khorne army idled at the positions assigned to the initial High Elf army instead of engaging.

  • Fixed an issue where the Beastmen allies that arrive late in Tamurkhan's 'The Gates of Nuln' quest battle did not move from their spawn point.

  • Fixed an issue so that the Skaven now will attempt to surround the player during the Crown of Saphery quest battle.

  • Fixed an issue to improve enemy unit behaviour in Sigvald's Auric Armour quest battle.

Quest & Adventure Battles

  • Fixed an issue where the Cultists of Nurgle in Fatsod's army appeared distorted during Kayzk's Devotion battle and disappeared from the roster entirely after loading a save.

  • The Nurgle Lord Morboth no longer has a missing model and icon in the Changeling's 'Eye of the Storm' Grand Scheme battle.

  • Khalida is no longer missing her unit card and in-battle Lord portrait in the 'Vanquisher of the Undead' quest battle.

  • The enemy army in Malakai Makaisson's 'Vampireslayer' adventure battle no longer uses a placeholder porthole.

  • Kaleth, the Supreme Sorceress in Alith Anar's 'Moonbow' quest battle, now uses the correct model instead of the Grey Wizard model.

  • Morathi now has her full set of spells and abilities in the 'Heartrender & The Darksword' quest battle when it is started from the Front End.

  • The abilities listed for Epidemius in the 'Sands of Sickness' quest battle menu now match the abilities he receives in the battle itself.

  • The Changeling's units now use the correct blue and gold banner when his quest battles are played through the Front End.

  • Fixed a discrepancy between the enemy army spawn location shown in the Front End and the one used in battle for 'The Nightmare of Hexensnacht Eve'.

  • Fixed an issue where the starting Empire army was poorly deployed in Vlad's 'Blood Drinker' quest battle when the battle was started from the campaign.

  • Enemy reinforcements no longer arrive from the wrong direction in Isabella's 'Blood Chalice of Bathory' quest battle.

  • Wulfrik's 'Sword of Torgald' quest battle now correctly ends once the reinforcements have been defeated.

  • The objective in the 'Ancestor Relic of Valaya' quest battle now completes correctly when the enemy Lord is killed.

  • Removed a second Arbaal that was visible during the quest battle intro.

  • Rebalanced Bhashiva's quest battle, which was too difficult when started from the Front End. Routing units no longer rally.

  • Fixed a Lua error that appeared after the opening cinematic in several quest battles, including 'The Skull Staff' (Heinrich Kemmler), 'Sword of Torgald' (Wulfrik) and 'Ghal Maraz' (Karl Franz).

  • Fixed a Lua error that appeared at the start of deployment in all of Archaon's quest battles.

  • Fixed a Lua error that occurred when starting the 'Moonbow' quest battle.

  • Fixed several Lua errors that occurred when enemy reinforcements arrived during Malakai Makaisson's 'Goblin's Monstrosity' adventure battle. Reinforcements now enter from the correct locations.

  • Fixed multiple issues with The Root of Chaos quest battle, including:

    • Fixed an issue where Ariel was not appearing at the start of the battle.

    • Fixed an issue where Ariel’s countdown timer and channeling instructions were not appearing.

    • Fixed an issue where the visual effect for Ariel’s channeling location was missing.

    • Fixed an issue where Drycha was incorrectly appearing as both an enemy and an ally instead of switching from enemy to ally.

Maps & Environment

  • The defender's vanguard deployment area is now correctly marked in the Grey Rock Point minor settlement battle. The attacker's deployment and vanguard deployment areas have also been reworked.

  • Fixed an issue on the Zharr-Naggrund map where a siege tower placed in its default deployment position became stuck in water and could not path to the settlement walls.

  • Reworked the reinforcement lines, attacker deployment area and no-go zones on The Writhing Fortress, which previously offered very limited options for positioning reinforcements.

  • Fixed an issue in the siege battle of Altdorf where units would climb on top of an archway instead of passing under it.

  • Fixed an issue on the Hell Pit settlement map where some wall platforms were floating above the walls, preventing attackers from climbing them.

  • Fixed an issue on the Black Fortress siege map where reinforcements could enter the battlefield from impassable terrain and pass through a mountain. Reinforcements now arrive from sensible directions.

UI/UX

  • Fixed an issue where some units, such as Lion Chariots of Chrace, disappeared from their unit portholes for a few seconds during battle.

  • The Mournguls unit card now states that they cause Terror, matching their Regiment of Renown version.

  • Removed incorrect bullet points from several Tomb Kings units, including one that listed an Anti-Infantry Bonus they did not have.

  • Fixed a Lua error that occurred when the Deployment tour was closed after being started during a siege battle.

  • Fixed a Lua error triggered by the Rallying scripted tour when playing with the game language set to Korean.

Units & Models

  • Fixed an issue where Chaos Knights of Khorne and Chaos Knights of Khorne (Lances) used the Slaughterguard's torso and leg textures.

  • Fixed the colours on several Dark Elf cavalry shields, which were missing their gold ornaments.

  • The Daemon Slayer and Dragon Slayer now have the proper faction colours.

  • Fixed an issue where Louen Leoncoeur’s 3D model was missing mouth textures.

  • Fixed Stegadon’s missing eye texture.

  • Fixed smoothing issues on the Chaos Lord of Slaanesh’s helmets and legs.

  • Fixed normals issues on Kislev Tzar Guard (Great Weapons).

  • Fixed missing capes on Dwarf Rangers.

  • Fixed black texture edges on Arahan and Naestra’s lower LODs.

  • Improved transition between the different LOD visuals for Kostaltyn’s model.

  • Fixed faction tint issues on several Empire units.

  • Fixed an issue where Wrathmongers and the Bloodwake Berserkers (RoR) had texture holes behind their knee armor.

Animations

  • Fixed issues with a few animations on the Herald of Nurgle and the Plagueridden.

  • Fixed a visual issue where the Chaos Dwarf Skullcracker’s chain would flicker while moving forward.

VFX

  • The arm that claims the Blue Scribes on death now emerges from its portal correctly positioned.

  • The Bloodcrushers of Khorne now display the flaming VFX on their swords.

  • Exalted Heroes of Khorne now display their persistent flame VFX on their axes and eyes.

  • The Patriarch's satchel now displays its persistent smoke VFX while he is mounted on a warhorse.

  • The Daemonettes within the Pleasureseekers unit now dissipate in pink smoke on death, rather than remaining on the battlefield.

MULTIPLAYER

  • Fixed an issue in multiplayer campaigns where the third and final wave of enemies did not spawn during Karl Franz's 'Beast Slayer' quest battle, forcing players to wait out the battle timer.

MISCELLANEOUS

Audio, Sound & Subtitles

  • The subtitles in Queek Headtaker's 'Warp-stone Armour' quest battle intro now stay in sync with the dialogue instead of disappearing before the line has finished.

  • Fixed an issue where the subtitles flickered during the intro of 'The Search for Ceithin-Har' quest battle.

  • The Golden Knight Naryska Leysa’s footsteps now make a sound.

Text & Localisation

  • Fixed a typo in the name of the Warsphinx, which appeared as 'Warxphinx' in the level V building tooltip in the building browser.

  • Fixed inconsistent Italian translations of Looting and Sacking in the technology tree and character skills.

  • Fixed the German localisation of the Beastmen 'Winds of Malady' building.

  • Fixed a missing value in the Polish localisation of the Karak Eight Peaks Landmark effects tooltip for Skaven.

⚠ IMPORTANT

If you experience any issues after downloading the update, please take a moment to Verify the integrity of the game files first to ensure there were no issues when downloading. A step-by-step guide can be found in this article.

If the issues persist, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

Please note that user-generated mods may have compatibility issues with new game updates. If you are encountering performance or stability issues following a release, is recommended that you disable any mods you're running. If you continue to experience issues, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

item.title: Processional of the Damned — A Sneak Peek
item.description:
Lord Captains!

We know you have been eagerly awaiting insights into the upcoming Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader expansion. There is still some time until the warp route to the “Processional of the Damned” is open, but this does not prevent us from allowing you a glimpse through the veil.

Let us begin!

A Miracle of the Emperor

First of all, let us introduce Stella, your new companion:



Frail of body but resolute, Stella is a Miraculist — a unique individual whose supernatural abilities manifest as purifying flame and righteous divination. Her eyes bleed, and the cracks of her cold porcelain skin haemorrhage when she becomes a conduit of His will, yet such is the price of bringing retribution to the xenos, the mutant, and the heretic.

Raised by the Ecclesiarchy to be a living weapon, she is a unique asset — one whose life was never truly her own. Although, unbeknownst to them, the reality is that she is an unsanctioned psyker, her order does not see her as a witch or a mutant. For them, she is a miracle sent by the Emperor himself, bathing in His light.

When presented with the opportunity to bring her aboard your voidship, what will you choose to do with such a rare and unusual relic, Lord Captain? Will you forge her into an even greater weapon in the name of your ambition and the glory of the von Valancius dynasty? Will you decide to see a human in her, assist her in picking up her pieces, and make her your friend and ally? Or will you perhaps dive together, hand in hand, into madness and damnation, as you embrace her haunting visions of thousands of derelict voidships orbiting a dark star?

A Living Weapon

The Miraculist is a special kind of unsanctioned psyker whose powers are unstable, barely controlled, and dictated almost entirely by whim, religious zeal of the user or a change in their mood.

On the battlefield, they are as powerful as they are unpredictable.

Stella’s keystone ability is called the Psychic Trail. It is a psychic aura projected a few tiles around her — the worse the veil degradation, the greater the size of the aura.

Within its range, she is capable of unleashing spontaneous bursts of psychic energy via an ability called Psychic Flare by sacrificing a small percentage of her maximum wounds.

This energy then manifests in a form of random psychic abilities, either unique to Stella or belonging to the Pyromancy, the Sanctic or the Divination disciplines. These range from direct burst damage and debuffs to exotic buffs to herself and her allies. All of them are always of the area-of-effect type — none of them is ever single-target.

At the start of a battle, Stella’s powers will typically manifest as Pyromancy. But when the other psykers use powers belonging to the other disciplines around her, her own powers begin to gravitate to that discipline for a time. item.title: An Update on the Processional of the Damned
item.description:
Lord Captains!

We have important news regarding the Processional of the Damned DLC for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader. We’re sorry it took us so long to bring you this update — we had to figure out a few things before making this announcement.

Despite our best efforts to deliver the expansion by September as originally intended, it has become clear to us that it won't be ready in time. That's why, to ensure we deliver the experience players deserve, we have decided to delay the launch. The release window will be set to December, 2026 and is not expected to move any further.

We sincerely apologise for this situation, and greatly value your patience and understanding.

We realize that the longer wait might upset some of our fans, especially those who'd like to replay the game with ALL content out, but we want to deliver an expansion you'll truly enjoy.

However, we also acknowledge that it might negatively impact your plans. If you are an owner of Season Pass 2 on Steam and you wish to reconsider playing the DLC due to this delay, you are eligible for a refund of the Season Pass 2 through Steam Customer Support. Please note that this will remove Processional of the Damned and the Infinite Museion from your Steam account, and break any saved games made with the Infinite Museion DLC content activated.

If you wish to continue playing your previous save after a refund, you will need to obtain the Infinite Museion DLC separately at:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226770/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader__The_Infinite_Museion/

The Appearance Pack included in Season Pass 2 will be made free and integrated into the base game for everyone, and thus will not affect your saves. Note that this change will come slightly later to the other platforms.

With all this in mind, we believe being late is better than rushing the expansion at all costs. We hope that our community will agree with us, and not mind giving the DLC a bit more time in the oven for a better final experience.

It’s also definitely the time to share some long-anticipated details about the final expansion. Let us give you a glimpse of the new member of the Lord Captain’s retinue — Stella, the Miraculist, as well as the new Zealot archetype, a new weapon type, and much more:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2186680/view/713412222387224795

In the upcoming weeks, we will show more about what to expect from the Processional of the Damned, including new artwork, narrative, gameplay articles and various other details.

The Emperor Protects!

item.title: Feature Highlight - Spillway Level & Visual Design
item.description:
The new free update for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, Depths of the Damned, comes loaded with new content for the game! Including a new mission, live story, weapons and a boss fight.

In today’s Feature Highlight we will look specifically at the new mission, what it is all about and how it came to be. To help us journey through the tunnels of lower Tertium we have gathered Karl, Lucas and Sara, some of the people that worked on the new level. Take it away guys! 

“I am Karl, Senior Level Designer, and I’ve been one of the main developers on the new level.” ~ Karl

“My name is Lucas, I am the Associate Art Director on Darktide, and I help oversee the visual quality of the game.” ~ Lucas

“I am Sara, and I am the Lead Level Artist on Darktide, and mainly I make levels.” ~ Sara

New Level, Spillway 

This new mission, called Spillway, is part of a live story where the Agents of the Mourningstar set out to help out with tasks asked by different Tertium nobles. The first two missions in the story, without spoiling too much of the campaign, lead us deep into the depths of Tertium.

We will journey to the domain of the Ragged King, the leader of the Water Cartel, who needs us to investigate a spreading corruption.

The first two missions will feel familiar, but the story elements of these are completely new. After going through them you will end up in the new mission, Spillway, and for this one we have added mechanics not seen in Darktide before. 

It will be up to us to gather the warband and get ready to figure out what is going on, and as we progress through the mission, the story will unfold and we will encounter a threat we haven’t faced off against before in the form of a new boss! 

As exciting as that is, we won’t cover the boss battle today, since we don't want to spoil too much, instead we will focus on the level design of this new mission.

Veteran Darktide players will recognize the start point of the mission, as we will be close to the Torrent, the major water recycling facility of Hive Tertium. Familiar terrain down here if you have played any of the missions set in this area, ruled by the Water Cartel. As you progress however, it will start to look quite different. The further you go into the level, the more Nurgle corruption there will be, and the level design becomes more and more claustrophobic.

“In the beginning you can see the vast backdrops of the Hive, but as you go you get more and more into the level it gets more dense.” ~ Karl

Finally, if you push through the corruption, you will find yourself in the boss arena of the level, and it will be quite clear where the corruption stems from! 

Visual design 

There's been a lot of focus on the outskirts and outside of the Hive City lately, so we knew we wanted to do a level that was set inside again. After some internal pitching we settled on the concept of going deeper into Tertium than we have ever done before, and after some thinking we came up with Spillway.

“We looked at some different avenues to explore, but the one we got most excited about was going deeper into the Hive. The mood and vision came from there.” ~ Lucas 

Now we had to think of what the function of the area had, and we settled on this deep place filled with junk and water reservoirs, it’s basically the origin for one of the major life support systems of the Hive.

We then started to merge the visual elements with the gameplay design we had in mind, as we knew that the further players will progress, the more the infestation of Nurgle will be clear. As mentioned, the starting point looks familiar, but as you travel through the mission, we had to create a bunch of new assets and VFX, to really capture the corruption.

There are a lot of fleshy bits, buboes and pus added to the tunnels you will end up in! Some assets are made to look like living organisms, and we have used various inspiration from all the lovely Nurgle artwork and as always the tabletop miniatures themselves.

“I really like the mouth we added to an asset, it’s really creepy.” - Sara

This is one of the most infested and corrupted areas we have made so far in Darktide, and it was really fun for us to add all the bits and pieces to bring it to life! 

Level design & gameplay

So let’s look a bit at how the level plays out for you all. In the early parts of the level it is Darktide as usual. We will fight off waves of enemies as we progress deeper into Spillway. At a certain point you will happen upon a Moebian 6th outpost, and after taking out the leader of the outpost you will uncover a certain symbol that will be very important for the rest of the mission.

You then venture into a sprawling network of tunnels, and here we have added a mechanic we haven’t had in Darktide before, branching paths. We have these rooms where the warband needs to make a decision on what path to take, and the symbol you uncover earlier in the level is key to taking the right path. 

All paths lead to the same destination point, but making the wrong choice here results in a harsher experience for the players. It might be trapped, you might have locked doors to get through or extra tasks. We have tried to randomize it as much as possible so the level feels fresh upon replaying it. The symbol you need to look for itself is also randomized between playthroughs.

“The wrong paths should be hard, but not impossible.” ~ Karl

The warband doesn’t take this decision on a team basis either, so you can go in different directions, and we went to extra lengths to make it so you can see the other paths from the one you took yourself. 

This means that if you take the right path, and the rest of your team venture off on the wrong one, you can spot the hardships they have to endure, but you can’t help them until you get back together.

We will have two different points in the mission where this decision on what path to take will have to be made. The first time it’s between two paths, and the second time you will have three choices to really spice it up! 

In the end, all paths lead to the boss arena we mentioned earlier, and you will have to face off against the fulcrum of the corruption spreading in these tunnels. But we won’t go into the fight itself as we want players to get to experience this themselves, making this a good point to wrap up this Feature Highlight.

All in all, it has been really fun and challenging for us, adding the branching paths to this mission and getting to dress up old tunnels in Nurgle filth. We hope you are excited to assemble the Warband and get to the bottom of the corruption, and then be ready for a real tough fight once you get there!

That’s all for today. The free update, Depths of the Damned, comes to Darktide on the 29th of September, and in the meantime we will see you on the Mourningstar!

- The Darktide Team
